Scopely is looking for a DEI Partner to join our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion team within the People function, in Barcelona working on a hybrid basis from the hub.
At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.
We make sure our teams have everything they need to create amazing games. The People team manages everything from benefits & employee engagement to professional development opportunities and more!
What You’ll Do
We’re looking for an experienced DEI professional to enable the operational excellence of our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion function. This role is focused on delivery, coordination and support to ensure DEI programs, learning initiatives, and ERG operations are executed effectively, consistently, and at scale.
You will partner closely with the DEI Lead and DEI Partner, and collaborate cross-functionally across People, ERGs, Facilities, IT, Procurement, and hub teams. You’ll excel in this role if you like to turn ideas to action, organize events, treat everything with a detail-oriented mindset and can translate strategy to high-quality operational delivery.
Execute operations of DEI and ERG events and initiatives end-to-end, managing intake, logistics, cross-functional ticketing (Facilities, IT, Procurement), post-event insights, and ensuring smooth on-the-ground delivery
Coordinate cross-hub implementation of global DEI programs, supporting localization efforts, stakeholder alignment, and project tracking, ensuring programs are well-executed, scalable, and impactful
Maintain DEI operational infrastructure, including updating playbooks, documentation, templates, shared folders, and internal knowledge pages
Support DEI Learning Strategy, executing tasks as administer DEI Learning Pathways, logistics and communication for new learning initiatives and track participation and engagement metrics
Manage vendor logistics and procurement workflows, including collecting quotes, processing contracts and similar documentation, tracking approvals, coordinating speakers and approvals, and maintaining partner records
Support ERG operations in partnership with the DEI Partner, coordinating event logistics globally, budget tracking, and engagement reporting within our ERG Management System
Track and compile participation data across programs and in support of Spain-specific compliance processes, assisting with documentation and administrative coordination related to the Gender Equality Plan, LGD, and Real Decreto LGTBI+
What We’re Looking For
3 years of program or project management experience, ideally in DEI, Corporate Social Responsibility, People, Employee Experience or Learning functions
Experience executing end-to-end global programs across multiple regions
Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and/or projects simultaneously
Comfortable working with data to track engagement and measure program effectiveness
Familiarity with vendor management and procurement workflows
Passion for operational execution with attention to detail and process rigor
Strong collaboration, written and verbal communication skills in English
Solutions-focused mindset with ownership and follow-through
Please submit your CV in English.
About Scopely
Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.
Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.
Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

회사 소개

쿠팡이츠서비스(Coupang Eats Services)는 Delivery service에 대한 차별화 전략을 세우고, 쿠팡이츠의 고객, 상점주, 그리고 배달파트너들에게 한층 더 강화된 서비스와 지원을 제공하고 있습니다.
쿠팡이츠서비스는 원하는 음식을 언제 어디서든 빠르고 안전하게 배달함으로써 고객에게 놀라운 고객 경험을 선사하고, 상점주에게는 주문부터 배달, 고객응대까지 제공하는 원스톱 서비스를 통해 안정적인 판매 기회를 확보할수 있는 시스템을 운영하고 있습니다.
여러 분야의 전문가로 구성된 쿠팡이츠서비스는 하나의 팀으로서 고객과 상점주, 배달파트너가 원하는 가치를 고민하고 연구하며, 새로운 혁신과 패러다임 변화를 이끌어가고 있습니다.

직무 소개

Operations Strategy 팀은 딜리버리 벤더 생태계를 고도화하고 성장 구조를 설계하는 전략 팀입니다.
운영이 고도화된 환경에서는 CX 기반 세일즈 타겟 도출과 벤더향 데이터 솔루션 상품화에 집중하고, 신규 지역에서는 계약 모델 설계부터 세일즈 및 현장 오퍼레이션 관리까지 사업 전반을 리드합니다.
각 시장에 최적화된 전략과 데이터 솔루션을 통해 전사 딜리버리 인프라의 경쟁력을 강화합니다.

업무 내용

• 글로벌 푸드딜리버리 3PL 생태계를 관통하는 계약 모델 설계, 사업 타당성 검토 및 타겟팅 전략 수립
• 파트너십 리스크와 수익성을 균형 있게 고려한 거버넌스 및 상업적 프레임워크 구축, 데이터 솔루션의 아이디어 도출부터 유상 상품화까지 End-to-End 라이프사이클 총괄
• 다양한 팀과의 협업을 통해 전략적 요구사항이 실제 시스템 로직 및 신규 기능으로 구현되도록 리드
• 지역별 수요 및 CX 예측 상황을 반영한 최적 오더량/목표 도출 및 오퍼레이션 거버넌스 수립
• 거시경제, 산업 트렌드, 규제 변화 및 경쟁 환경에 대한 데이터 기반의 리서치·분석 체계 구축
• 주요 실행 지표(KPI) 정의, 대시보드 트래킹 체계 구축, 원인 분석을 통한 지속적인 비즈니스 및 CX 개선 이끌기

자격 요건

• 10년 이상의 관련 직무 경력을 보유하신 분
• 복잡하고 방대한 Raw Data를 구조화하여 실행 가능한 비즈니스 전략 및 기능으로 전환해 본 경험과 데이터 기반 문제 해결 능력을 보유하신 분
• 정답이 정해지지 않은 환경에서 신규 이니셔티브를 정의하고 End-to-End로 프로젝트를 완수한 경험을 보유하신 분
• 다양한 이해관계자 간의 우선순위를 정렬하고 의사결정을 이끌어내는 영향력을 보유하신 분
• 비즈니스 수준급 영어 또는 일본어 소통이 가능하신 분

우대 사항

• 이커머스, 퀵커머스/인스턴트 커머스, 라스트마일, 3PL 물류, 글로벌 플랫폼 경험을 보유하신 분
• 한국-일본 간 크로스보더 프로젝트 또는 글로벌 비즈니스 스케일업/롤아웃 리딩 경험을 보유하신 분
• SQL, Superset, Power BI 등 데이터 분석 툴 활용 능력 및 데이터 모델링에 대한 높은 이해도를 보유하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

• 전형절차

• 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격

• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

• 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

서류 반환 정책

jobs.description: Job Description: Brooks Instrument ( www.brooksinstrument.com ), an industry leader in flow and pressure instrumentation for critical applications, is seeking candidates for a Quality Engineering Team Leader position that will be based at the company headquarters in Hatfield, Pennsylvania (suburban Philadelphia). Demonstrated experience leading work, coordinating priorities, training others, or providing technical direction in a production or quality environment required; prior formal supervisory experience is helpful but not required. Experience working within an ISO 9001 or other third-party certified quality-management system required. Experience leading root-cause analysis, corrective action, nonconforming-material disposition, process audits, and cross-functional problem solving required. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to distinguish immediate containment from true corrective and preventive action. Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook; experience with Minitab or similar statistical software preferred. Experience with electronic quality-management systems and data/reporting tools; TrackWise experience preferred. Diplomacy and sound judgment when communicating with customers, suppliers, registrars, assessors, and other external contacts. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, cross-functional manufacturing environment with a strong focus on customer satisfaction. Ability to support business needs across shifts and travel domestically or internationally on an occasional basis. Review customer documentation and requirements, including special quality, inspection, documentation, or copy-exact expectations, and ensure appropriate fulfillment. jobs.description: Come be a part of Amazon's dynamic Live Sports Production team. We are looking for an experienced Sr. Production Operations Manager who brings both strategic business acumen and hands-on production expertise to own the end-to-end lifecycle of multiple live sports properties, from initial financial modeling and vendor strategy through boots-on-the-ground execution. In this role, you will serve as the centralized operational lead for your assigned properties, driving strategic planning across the full project lifecycle. You will lead financial modeling, shape vendor strategy, and manage engagement with third-party Production Service Partners (PSPs), coordinating backend functions including crewing, payroll, travel, and production accounting while maintaining Amazon's operational standards and ensuring productions launch on time and on budget. Equally critical is your ability to deliver on the ground. You will work in lockstep with internal crewing, editorial, and technical workstreams to ensure each event or studio show is properly resourced, and will partner directly with PSPs to establish best practices, define operational standards, and ensure alignment across the vendor landscape. You will drive production readiness across all operational workstreams, ensuring each event is prepared for a clean launch and seamless restart. This role requires deep knowledge of remote, event, and studio production operations, including broadcast positions, industry standard rates, vendor engagement models, and production service agreements. You will be responsible for issue spotting, driving decision making, and escalating matters that carry risk to the Global Head of Production Operations. Our production operation is purpose-built around the needs of an expanding, multi-sport live portfolio rather than modeled after a traditional broadcast network structure. We are defining and building as we evolve, and this person must be excited to roll up their sleeves and help establish the systems, relationships, and workflows that will scale with us. The successful candidate is a self-starter who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment. You can juggle competing priorities across multiple productions with autonomy, react with urgency when situations demand immediate attention, and bring a proven track record of end-to-end ownership in a fast-paced, evolving business. Key job responsibilities • End-to-End Property Lifecycle Management: Own and manage the full project lifecycle for assigned properties, from projected business scope and production roadmap development, through execution and ongoing supervision of day-to-day live event and studio production, to post-mortem and financial reconciliation. Develop milestones, launch schedules, and workback timelines to ensure successful delivery of property launches and season restarts. Lead property transition planning for returning seasons, ensuring operational continuity, vendor re-engagement, and incorporation of prior-season learnings into the restart roadmap. • Business Strategy and Vendor Management: Develop a deep understanding of organizational business objectives and production priorities to drive vendor evaluation, selection, and strategic recommendations that optimize cost, quality, and scalability across assigned properties. Shepherd the vendor selection process through RFPs and serve as the primary point of contact for vendors defining scope of work, deliverables, and engagement standards. Partner with Legal and Production Finance on contract terms, rate frameworks, and commercial agreements, and monitor vendor performance to ensure accountability against operational standards. • Budget and Financial Management: Create and manage production budgets from initial scoping through execution. Work closely with Production Finance to track and reconcile all production costs, ensuring external vendors and the production team are aware of overall spend. Coordinate fee reconciliation and payment processing with third-party vendors to ensure accuracy and timeliness. Lead regular financial status updates to senior leadership, flagging variances and recommending corrective action. • Crewing Coordination via PSPs: Ensure assigned properties are properly staffed by coordinating crew deployment through third-party vendors. Establish consistent frameworks for how Above-The-Line (ATL) and Below-The-Line (BTL) personnel are engaged across productions. Partner with the centralized crewing function to maintain visibility into crew availability, prevent scheduling conflicts, and ensure alignment with creative and editorial vision. Support rate structure consistency and market-competitive positioning across comparable roles. • On-Site Event Operations and Health & Safety: Oversee on-site event production operations, including venue logistics and coordination with league and arena broadcast groups. Ensure Health & Safety protocols and risk management standards are maintained across all production environments. Work with vendors and internal teams to identify and mitigate operational risks in advance of air, and maintain contingency plans for live production scenarios. • Labor and Workforce Compliance: Navigate both union and non-union production environments. Ensure third-party PSPs adhere to all applicable labor regulations and collective bargaining agreements. Work closely with Amazon's internal legal and labor teams to stay current on regulatory requirements, workforce compliance standards, and crew classification guidelines across domestic and international markets. Advise on compliance considerations as they arise, including jurisdictional rules and engagement terms. • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Amazon teams including Editorial Production, Technical Operations, Business Development, Production Finance, Accounting, and Legal to operationalize properties and drive synergy. Align regularly with production teams across regions to share best practices and integrate new learnings. Support the Global Head of Production Ops in implementing operational strategy across all Prime Video Live Sports properties. • Escalation and Risk Management: Proactively identify issues and blockers, providing timely solutions to resolve them. Exercise sound judgment in issue spotting and decision making, escalating to senior leadership when matters carry risk or require broader organizational alignment. Lead regular status updates on project timelines, budgets, and production readiness. • Operational Process Improvement and Scalability: Seek continuous improvements in execution of existing productions. Recommend changes to operational strategy, seek alignment with stakeholders, and implement at regular intervals. Own and leverage internal production management tools to maintain full visibility into productions, track resource deployment, and surface issues. Contribute to frameworks, SOPs, and systems that enable the team to scale with increasing property volume and complexity. About the team The Production Operations team is responsible for delivering high-quality event and studio productions on all global live sports properties to Prime Video customers worldwide. We drive production excellence through purpose-built processes and scalable operational frameworks that empower the team to work more efficiently and grow with increasing demand.

Design Program Managers make DoorDash's Design Studio run better. As owner of the Logistics pillar within Design Operations, you're accountable for one of our most important operating outcomes: maximizing the bandwidth of the team.

About the Role

You'll find where ICs and managers lose time, fragmented workflows, manual processes, meeting overload, unclear rhythms, and you'll define and build the tools and systems that fix it. That might mean shipping a new internal tool, automating a recurring workflow, redesigning how scheduling or reviews work, or establishing a better operating cadence. You own the full loop: diagnose the problem, design the system, build the tool, measure whether it worked.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Own the Logistics outcome, maximize the bandwidth of the team. ICs and managers have more usable time. Meeting load decreases. The team can focus on high-value work.
• Identify the biggest sources of operational drag across the Studio and turn them into a prioritized roadmap of tools and process fixes.
• Define and build the tools, automations, and workflows that reduce manual coordination, including for scheduling, budgets, vendor management, and event logistics.
• Redesign how the Studio operates: reviews, planning cadences, rhythms for both ICs and managers, information flows, whatever determines how fast teams can move.
• Measure whether your systems work, usable time for ICs and managers, meeting load, adoption, hours of manual work eliminated, and iterate.
• Turn recurring requests into scalable solutions. The second time a problem shows up, build the thing that stops a third.
• Own scheduling, budget, vendor, and logistics programs as a builder, not a permanent executor, your job is to make them need less manual effort every quarter.
• Partner with (and, as scope grows, help develop) other DPMs on the Logistics pod.

We're excited about you because you have…

• 5+ years in operations, program management, or business operations, building systems and tools that made a complex org run better. Design/product/creative org experience is a plus; EA or Chief of Staff backgrounds are welcome if you've built beyond pure execution.
• A builder mindset: you've created tools, workflows, or automations that replaced manual work — not just performed manual work well.
• Product-manager instincts applied to operations: find the real pain point, diagnose root cause, prototype, ship, measure, iterate.
• The ability to own an outcome independently at L4/L5 scope — you don't need the problem pre-scoped for you.
• Comfort with AI and no-code tooling (Claude, Cursor, Figma, or similar) to prototype and ship internal tools without needing an engineer.
• Strong written/verbal communication and the judgment to handle sensitive leadership and operational info with discretion.

What success looks like

Maximize the bandwidth of the team. ICs and managers have more usable time. Meeting load decreases. Team can focus on high-value work. Manual workflows become automated. Recurring problems become systems that scale. Your job is to create capacity — not just manage it.

Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

jobs.description: Amazon Manufacturing Services (AMS) is seeking an experienced Sr. Process Engineer to join our advanced manufacturing team. This role will drive manufacturing excellence through the application of AI/ML technologies, simulation and digital twin development, and advanced process optimization across existing production facilities and new projects. This role serves as a critical bridge between manufacturing operations, product engineering, and emerging AI/ML technologies. Key job responsibilities 1. Lead data-driven throughput improvement initiatives across current production lines 2. Conduct bottleneck analysis using simulation and real-world data to identify constraints 3. Execute cycle time reduction projects through AI-optimized process parameters 4. Develop and implement setup optimization strategies to maximize output against existing equipment and labor constraints 5. Apply statistical process control and continuous improvement methodologies enhanced by ML insights 6. Design and optimize automated manufacturing processes including robotic pick-and-place, material handling, and assembly operations 7. Develop control strategies for multi-robot coordination and collaborative automation 8. Implement vision systems, sensors, and data collection infrastructure for AI/ML model training 9. Bridge simulation-to-reality gap by validating digital twin predictions against production performance 10. Build predictive models for throughput optimization, bottleneck identification, and capacity planning 11. Train AI agents to learn optimal manufacturing strategies through simulation before deployment to production 12. We are the engineering team responsible for transforming manufacturing concepts into operational reality, from facility layout and workstation design to process optimization and equipment integration. Our scope spans new facility launches and ongoing expansion and improvement of existing manufacturing operations, supporting advanced manufacturing and assembly of light industrial equipment. The team is in a high-growth phase, with significant opportunity to shape manufacturing design standards and scalable solutions that will define how Amazon builds and operates its manufacturing capabilities.

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic leader to build ElevenLabs' public sector business across the Middle East. The Public Sector Partnerships Lead will identify and build relationships with government institutions across the region, bridging the gap between government and our GTM team to drive adoption of ElevenLabs' products and grow government into a strong, durable revenue stream for the company. The role also involves building strategic partnerships with policymakers, industry associations, and coalitions, as well as monitoring regulatory developments and supporting policy campaigns and impact initiatives.

In this role, you will:

Drive government adoption and revenue (primary)

- Identify government partnership opportunities across the Middle East — from healthcare and education to smart city initiatives, sovereign wealth funds, and other state-owned enterprises — and bridge the gap between government institutions and the GTM team to drive adoption and deployment of ElevenLabs' products.

- Build and maintain a wide network of relationships across government institutions in the region — spanning ministries, regulatory authorities, sovereign funds, and SOEs across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and beyond — not limited to regulatory or policy counterparts.

- Promote government adoption of ElevenLabs products and services in partnership with the GTM team.

Build strategic partnerships (secondary)

- Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, regulators, industry associations, and civil society groups.

- Represent ElevenLabs at conferences and industry events, advancing the company's public policy goals.

Monitor and advise on policy (tertiary)

- Lead ElevenLabs engagement with government bodies and officials across the Middle East, with a focus on AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and/or digital rights.

- Monitor, analyze, and advise on emerging regulations impacting the company.

- Support the development of internal policies by our Legal, Safety, Security, and other teams.

- Provide strategic counsel to company leadership on regional policy trends and their business implications.

- Define and implement policy campaigns and impact initiatives that advance company objectives.

Who you are:

- You're genuinely interested in the future of AI and emerging technologies, bringing curiosity and enthusiasm to your role.

- You stay up-to-date on AI regulation and industry trends, and are eager to apply this expertise to cutting-edge products.

- You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment, working cross-functionally with teams across the organization to support and scale a growing business.

- You're comfortable working independently and handling ambiguity, excelling in situations where you must make informed decisions quickly.

- You bring a proactive, solution-oriented approach to each project, focused on moving the business forward.

What you bring:

Primary requirements

- 10–15 years' experience in public and private sector (in-house, firm) roles, with a track record of building relationships with government that led to commercial or technology-adoption outcomes — not solely policy or regulatory roles.

- A wide, current network of contacts across government institutions in the Middle East — spanning ministries, regulatory authorities, sovereign wealth funds, and SOEs, with particular depth in the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Relationships at the level of government decision-makers and technology buyers are essential; prior government experience is a plus but not required if network breadth and seniority are strong.

- Experience identifying and opening doors for technology partnerships with government institutions is strongly preferred.

- Contacts or experience across other GCC markets (Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman) is a plus.

Also required

- Strong knowledge of the regional AI policy landscape, including general AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and digital rights.

- Demonstrated success in designing, advocating for, and influencing policy outcomes, as well as coalition building.

- Public policy experience across the UAE and broader Middle East.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including when briefing government officials and other policymakers.

- Fluency in English and Arabic.

Location

This role is located in Dubai.

jobs.description:
Company Introduction
We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar e-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest-growing e-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.
We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.
Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional trade-offs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.
Role Overview
Fulfilment Optimization (FO) owns the systems that decide how every Coupang order is planned, distributed, and fulfilled. Our Tier-1 services sit on the critical path of Coupang's ecommerce order flow — processing every order in real time across Korea and Taiwan. We operate multiple interconnected platform components:
-Business Engine — Core order planning and distribution orchestrator (Kotlin/Spring Boot). Runs 5 distinct pipelines (Domestic, Cross-Market, 3PL, PDD, Replan) using a hexagonal architecture with pluggable processors, pruners, and manifest-based orchestration.
-Planner Solver — Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP) optimization engine (Python/CPLEX) that minimizes total fulfilment cost across inventory, capacity, network, and delivery-promise constraints with sub-second latency requirements.
-Network Manager — Manages fulfilment network topology, transportation cost, FC capacity, middle-mile logistics, and cross-FC consolidation (CFCC) across 90+ REST/gRPC endpoints.
-FO Inventory — Real-time inventory availability, allocation, SKU management, and event-driven sync across multiple upstream sources (Kafka, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Redis).
-WMS Fulfilment — Order distribution, inventory allocation, fulfilment centre orchestration, shipment, delivery, and outbound management (Java/Spring, 138+ domain subpackages, Drools rules engine).
-Online Simulation — Real-time simulation platform for testing planning changes against production-like order streams.
-FO Workflows — Temporal-based workflow orchestration for long-running fulfilment processes.
The Role
We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer who can operate across deep implementation and broad architecture. You will set the technical direction for Tier-1 fulfilment systems, write and review production code, design systems that scale under heavy ecommerce traffic, and raise the engineering bar across the organization. The engineer in this role will directly influence how millions of orders are fulfilled every day. Every architectural decision — solver latency, pruning strategy, network cost calculation, inventory allocation algorithm impacts
customer delivery promise, fulfilment cost, and operational efficiency across Coupang's entire ecommerce platform in Korea and Taiwan.
This is a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, real-time optimization, and ecommerce fulfilment — with direct, measurable business impact.
What You Will Do
-Design and build scalable, reliable Tier-1 services for order planning, fulfilment optimization, inventory allocation, and network cost management — systems that process every Coupang order in real time.
-Own architecture across distributed systems involving gRPC service meshes, Kafka event pipelines, CPLEX optimization solvers, multi-layer caching (Redis, S3-backed Loadable Stores), and multi-region deployments.
-Write production code in Kotlin and Java and set the bar for correctness, performance, and operational safety across the team.
-Lead design and code reviews — identify correctness issues, scalability risks, and operational gaps in systems handling latency-sensitive order flows (sub-second solver deadlines, P99 monitoring with 3-5s alert thresholds).
-Drive reliability for mission-critical services — circuit breakers, graceful degradation (hard/soft pruners with fallback), observability, and incident prevention.
-Partner with Product, Data Science, and Operations to translate fulfilment optimization goals into technical execution — PDD rationalization, CFCC (Cross-FC Consolidation), CFlow transport planning, inventory group management, and solver model improvements.
-Mentor engineers and create durable technical mechanisms (pipeline patterns, adapter abstractions, feature flag discipline) that scale beyond individual projects
Basic Qualifications
-Proven experience designing and operating high-scale distributed systems with strict latency and reliability requirements
-Excellent hands-on coding ability in Kotlin or Java (backend systems at scale)
-Deep understanding of system design — API design, concurrency, data modelling, caching strategies, messaging, service-to-service communication (gRPC, REST)
-Strong code review skills — ability to identify subtle correctness, performance, and reliability issues in complex
codebases
-Experience with production-grade systems handling high QPS, large data volumes, or Tier-1 SLAs
-Experience with event-driven architectures using Kafka at scale
-Experience with multi-region systems — region-specific routing, data isolation, cross-border fulfilment
-Experience with resilience engineering — circuit breakers, retry strategies, load testing, capacity planning, graceful degradation patterns
-Track record of technical leadership — setting architecture direction, driving cross-team alignment, mentoring senior engineers
Preferred Qualifications
-Experience in ecommerce, fulfilment, supply chain, logistics, inventory, order management, or planning systems
-Experience with optimization systems — solvers (CPLEX, OR-Tools), decision engines, constraint programming, or data-science-integrated production systems
-Experience with Agentic AI tools for development and code review — using AI-assisted coding agents (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, Devin, Claude Code) to accelerate development velocity, improve code review quality, and automate repetitive engineering tasks
-Experience with Spec-Driven Development — defining system behaviour through specifications (OpenAPI/Swagger, Protocol Buffers, API-first design, contract-first development) before implementation, ensuring well-defined contracts between services
Type of work model
Hybrid

jobs.description: Join CoolIT, an Ecolab Company, a global leader in Direct Liquid Cooling technology for data centers, supercomputers, and high-performance computing environments. Occasional schedule flexibility and overtime may be required based on production and business needs. Minimum Qualifications Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in Quality, Inventory Control, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Operations, or a related environment. Experience working with ERP systems and inventory transaction management. Experience with quality management systems and non-conformance processes. Experience coordinating activities across multiple departments and stakeholders. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive tasks to completion. Effective communication and collaboration skills in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Ability to safely move and manage materials within designated inventory and quarantine areas. Ability to exert up to 20 kg (44 lbs.) occasionally, up to 10 kg (22 lbs.) frequently, and up to 5 kg (11 lbs.) constantly. This role operates in a manufacturing environment and may require occasional exposure to production floor conditions, noise, moving mechanical equipment, dust, and changing environmental conditions. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Material Review Board (MRB) processes and management of non-conforming materials. Experience with NetSuite ERP. Experience with quality management systems such as SolveIT. Knowledge of ISO 9001 or similar quality management systems. Previous experience in a lead, coordinator, or supervisory capacity. Experience supporting continuous improvement initiatives. Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, hands-on approach to driving results. We thank every candidate in advance; however, we will contact only those selected for an interview. Please note: immigration sponsorship is not available for this role. Successful candidates for this position will be required to undergo background checks, including criminal record checks and education verification. ABOUT COOLIT, AN ECOLAB COMPANY Founded in Calgary, Alberta in 2001, CoolIT Systems is the leading Direct Liquid Cooling technology provider for data centers, supercomputers, and desktop computers. We design and manufacture solutions used by the largest tech companies globally. Recognized as one of “The Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies 2023” by Financial Times and honored with the Deloitte Fast 50 Clean Technology award in 2022, as well as the Deloitte Fast 500 distinction in both 2021 and 2022, CoolIT's rapid growth is capturing global attention. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Partners Solutions Architect on Anthropic's Applied AI team, you'll be a pre-sales architect focused on building technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs) and cloud partners (AWS and GCP). You'll strengthen these relationships to accelerate indirect revenue, enable partners' AI practices, and execute our long-term go-to-market strategy.

Responsibilities

•

Strategic technical partnership: Act as a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team. Bring technical expertise to help us understand the partner landscape, drive key strategic programs, and find ways to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. You'll also serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.

•

Joint solution development: Work with partners to identify high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions, and codify reference architectures and best practices that speed time to deployment.

•

Customer deal support: Step in to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.

•

Partner ecosystem and events: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, AWS summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.

•

Product feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns. Deliver it to the relevant Anthropic teams to inform the product roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

•

5+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles, such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager

•

A track record of partnering successfully with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery

•

Exceptional ability to build relationships and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders, including C-suite executives and engineering and IT teams

•

Strong presentation and technical communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders

•

Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems

•

Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools, or a background in machine learning or data science

•

Enthusiasm for cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities

•

A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed

•

A passion for using technology in ways that are safe and beneficial, and that advance the goal of safe AI systems

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

£150,000—£190,000 GBP

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic's enterprise business is growing fast, and enterprises are adopting Claude across product surfaces. Before they can deploy at scale, they need the same foundations everywhere: security and compliance controls, identity and access management, data governance, admin controls, and cost and spend management. This work is especially critical for customers in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, public sector), whose security, privacy, and resilience requirements set the bar for everyone else.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to partner with the teams that own these enterprise foundations, own the planning and execution rhythm that gets each capability onto every surface, and contribute to a coherent leadership view of coverage, gaps, and progress across products. This is a senior role: product, engineering, and GTM leaders will look to you for where we stand on enterprise readiness and for the plan to close the gaps.

Responsibilities

• Run the planning and operating cadence for the foundational-capability roadmap across surfaces: clear DRIs, sequenced dependencies, and a single source of truth on coverage and status for product, engineering, and GTM leadership
• Drive the highest-priority foundational capability programs end to end, from scoping and tradeoff decisions through delivery on every surface
• Shape the readiness bar for new products and features: what a surface must have in place before it reaches enterprise customers, and the call on in-flight features that are missing controls
• Work across teams and directly with customers: partner with sales, customer success, solutions, and support on active deals and escalations, join customer security and compliance reviews, and bring what enterprises are blocked on back to product and engineering
• Translate customer and regulatory requirements into technical programs: work with legal, compliance, and GTM to prioritize the highest-impact enterprise asks and map them to roadmaps with dates

Sample projects include

• Take a regulated customer's security control assessment from findings to closed gaps, with owners and dates across product, security, and infrastructure
• Stand up a data residency program: gather requirements by market, what each surface must support, and sequencing with infrastructure
• Build the operating model for co-building with a large enterprise design partner: staffing, cadence, and how their asks reach the roadmap
• Extend healthcare compliance coverage to new product surfaces, with a migration path customers can actually take

You may be a good fit if you

• Have 8+ years of technical program management experience, with a track record of building cross-functional programs from scratch in ambiguous environments
• Have driven decisions among senior leaders with competing priorities, and are comfortable plainly articulating what is and is not ready for enterprise customers
• Have driven adoption of platform or horizontal capabilities across product teams that don't share a reporting line, where success depended on other teams building on what you shipped
• Understand what enterprises require before they adopt at scale, particularly for customers in regulated industries: security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP), identity and access (SSO, SCIM, RBAC), data governance (retention, residency, customer-managed keys), audit logging, and spend controls
• Have worked directly with regulated customers on their security reviews, questionnaires, audit findings, and contract redlines, and understand how control design, evidence collection, and engineering delivery fit together
• Thrive when the operating model itself is still being defined and see shaping it as part of the job

Strong candidates may also have

• Owned a HIPAA program end to end at a software company, including BAAs, PHI handling, and supporting product controls
• Worked with financial services customers on data retention, data residency, and encryption requirements (including retention and deletion commitments, regional hosting, customer-managed keys, and contractual evidence and attestations)
• Run a design partnership or co-build with a large enterprise customer
• Experience using Claude or other LLM tooling to automate program tracking and reporting

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$365,000—$435,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Emergency Changes
Production Deployments

Release Compliance

Control Effectiveness
SoD Violations
Emergency Changes
